title: Territory, Borders, and Boundary Disputes in International Law
description: This article explains territory, borders, and boundary disputes in international law, including territorial sovereignty, territorial integrity, acquisition of territory, title, effective control, maps, treaties, uti possidetis juris, colonial boundaries, self-determination, land and maritime delimitation, rivers, islands, enclaves, occupation, annexation, Palestine, Ukraine, Western Sahara, Kashmir, and the role of courts, arbitration, and political negotiation in resolving territorial disputes.
primary_source_types: International Court of Justice territorial and boundary cases
Permanent Court of Arbitration and Reports of International Arbitral Awards materials
United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea materials
United Nations decolonization and self-determination materials
